name: Vidhya Sadhana Yojana Gujarat
benefit: - Free bicycles given to the scheduled tribal girl students as a gift.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a girl student. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The applicant should be studying in class 9th in a recognized school.1. The applicant’s annual family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-.
